sbh2.1:1.3: Printed *catvāryāryālambana-*; read *catvāry ālambana-*, the *-āry-* a dittography (Xuanzang 四種所緣境事, T1579 juan 26; cf. 9.2).
sbh2.1:4.5: Printed *sātatyaṁ*; read *śāntatvaṁ* 'calmness' (Xuanzang 上地靜性, T1579 juan 26; cf. 13.2–13.3). Printed text omits *duḥkhasatyaṁ*; supplied from Xuanzang 苦諦 (T1579 juan 26; cf. 13.4).
sbh2.1:5.5: Xuanzang (T1579 juan 26) negates this clause, 非現領受和合現前 'is not directly experienced, assembled, present'; the English follows the printed text.
sbh2.1:6.6: Printed *asaktaṁ ca arthākāreṇa tannimittaṁ śamayati*; read *śamathākāreṇa tac cittaṁ śamayati* (Xuanzang 以奢摩他行寂靜其心, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:6.15: Printed text omits the other names; Xuanzang (T1579 juan 26) lists eight: image, samādhi-sign, samādhi-range, samādhi-mouth, samādhi-door, locus of attention, inner construction, and reflection (亦名影像 … 亦名光影).
sbh2.1:7.4: Printed text omits the negation; supplied from Xuanzang 更無餘 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:7.9: Printed *tathatā ca tasṛbhir*; read *tathatā catasṛbhir* 'by the four' (Xuanzang 由四道理, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:8.9: Printed text omits *dvitīyatṛtīya-*; supplied from Xuanzang 得第二第三第四靜慮時 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:8.10: Printed text omits *dvitīyatṛtīya-*; supplied from Xuanzang 於第二第三第四靜慮所行境界 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:9.4: Printed *bāhyālambanam*; read *vyāpyālambanam* (Xuanzang 遍滿所緣, T1579 juan 26; cf. 9.6, 19.8).
sbh2.1:10.1: Printed text omits the *nirvikalpa* member; Xuanzang (T1579 juan 26) has it: 若說無分別影像，即是此中奢摩他品 'the image without conceptual construction is the *śamatha* side'.
sbh2.1:12.2: Printed *sa na śubhālambane*; read *so 'śubhālambane* (Xuanzang 應於不淨緣安住於心, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:13.1: Printed *kintu kauśalye*; read *skandhakauśalye* (Xuanzang 應於蘊善巧安住其心, T1579 juan 26; cf. 4.3).
sbh2.1:13.2: Printed text omits the fourth skill; Xuanzang (T1579 juan 26) has it: 若愚無常、苦、空、無我，應於緣起、處非處善巧安住其心 'one confused about impermanence, suffering, emptiness, and non-self binds the mind to skill in dependent origination and in the possible and impossible'.
sbh2.1:13.4: Printed *nirvekṣukāmo*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 樂通達 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.1:14.1: Printed text omits the question heading; supplied from Xuanzang 云何比丘勤修觀行，是瑜伽師，於相似緣安住其心 (T1579 juan 26; cf. 12.1).
sbh2.1:14.9: Printed text omits, after this segment, a sentence on calming the mind from time to time and practising *vipaśyanā*, and the closing formula of this answer; Xuanzang (T1579 juan 26) has them (又彼比丘，於時時間令心寂靜 … 是名 … 於相似緣安住其心) and reads 相似緣 'corresponding' where the printed text has *samyag eva*.
sbh2.1:15.1: Printed text omits the question heading; supplied from Xuanzang 云何比丘勤修觀行，是瑜伽師，於緣無倒安住其心 (T1579 juan 26; cf. 15.4).
sbh2.1:16.3: Printed *vigacchati*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 得證 (T1579 juan 26; cf. 15.12 *adhigacchati*).
